summary.zh-CN: 查美股财报和申报文件，写出每个数字都能追溯的研究报告
summary.en: Research US-listed companies from SEC filings, with every number traceable

zh-CN: 用 SEC EDGAR 的财报和申报文件研究美国上市公司：列计划、取数、自检、写报告
取数记录和原始数据都留在你的工作区；没有股价、PE 和筛选器
研究流程灵感来自开源项目 Dexter，不含其代码，也无关联。仅供参考，不构成投资建议
en: Researches US-listed companies from SEC EDGAR filings: plans, fetches, checks, then writes a report
Fetch logs and raw data stay in your workspace. It has no prices, PE ratios or stock screener
Inspired by the open-source Dexter project, with none of its code and no affiliation. Not investment advice

zh-CN: 研究英伟达近五年的收入和毛利率趋势，生成报告
对比微软和 Alphabet 近三年的收入和营业利润率
读特斯拉最新 10-K 的风险因素，总结最重要的五条
en: Research NVIDIA's revenue and gross margin trends over five years into a report
Compare Microsoft and Alphabet on revenue and operating margin over three years
Read Tesla's latest 10-K risk factors and summarize the top five
